Interface ClassifierContent

All Superinterfaces:
ClassifierInput
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClassifierContent.JsonArray, ClassifierContent.JsonObject, ClassifierContent.Text
@Experimental public sealed interface ClassifierContent extends ClassifierInput permits ClassifierContent.Text, ClassifierContent.JsonObject, ClassifierContent.JsonArray
Text or structured data that a Classifier reads as the input or as a question's instructions or criteria: plain ClassifierContent.Text, or a ClassifierContent.JsonObject or ClassifierContent.JsonArray. It mirrors Python ADK's JSONContent.
